verdict.rationale: PayPal's agent-discovery surface (Store Sync, ACP/UCP catalog feeds) is entirely merchant-side and gated: access requires completing a form so 'the AI team at PayPal' can approve onboarding, plus an existing Braintree or PayPal Orders v2 merchant relationship — the opposite of keyless or self-service, partnership-free access for an agent to search across arbitrary merchants. There is no API letting an AI agent programmatically query products across multiple merchants without this approval gate.
